pages.title: The Divine Chariot
pages.text: $(bold)Cult of Azazel's god: the Divine Chariot Azazel's scythe, spear and shield, its armour and its trophies.$(br2)$(thing)Industry$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(thing)48 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Champion.
